expectations.text: 用 Open Transition (Break-Before-Make, BBM) / Open Transition (BBM) 与 Closed Transition (Make-Before-Break, MBB) / Closed Transition (MBB)，缩写 BBM/MBB 原样保留不译
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "open transition (Break-Before-Make, BBM) and closed transition (Make-Before-Break, MBB)"; Table L27-28 retain BBM / MBB verbatim.

expectations.text: 规范性动词「应」译为 shall（如 shall ensure），不用 should 或 must
expectations.evidence: Body L17: "The mechanical interlocking mechanism shall ensure that the two power sources cannot be closed simultaneously."

expectations.text: 「恢复转换延时」译为 return transfer delay（可附 RTD），不用笼统 time delay
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "and the return transfer delay (RTD) can be set within the range of 0 s to 180 s."

expectations.text: 保留 100 ms / 1.5 s / 0 to 180 s（或 0–180 s），但明确标注这些时间参数未经对应型号数据表核实（IEC 60947-6-1 只定类别不定时间）
expectations.evidence: Body L13 keeps 100 ms, 1.5 s, 0 s to 180 s; L39 explicitly notes "IEC 60947-6-1 defines transfer switching equipment classes (Class PC and Class CB) and transition types (BBM / MBB), not fixed operating times or delay limits" and all three quantities "must trace to the official NZ7 product datasheet".

expectations.text: 保持 Track 2 说明书语体（完整规范性条款句式，未混入 Track 1 样本册营销压缩话术）
expectations.evidence: L4, L11-17, L41: maintains normative Track 2 OEM installation-and-operation manual prose (numbered clauses 4.3/4.4, "does not exceed", "is not greater than", "shall ensure") without Track 1 catalogue marketing phrasing.

expectations.text: 数字与单位之间严格有单个半角空格（100 ms / 1.5 s / 180 s），且正文无残留中文全角标点
